_meta.title: 风味辨识引导树（识别引导——B 最痛）
_meta.purpose: 把模糊的风味抱怨一步步引导到具体子类，再关联到根因与调整。identify_flavor 工具消费本文件：先按症状命中 family，再用 discriminators 提问，最终定位 leaf 给出 root_cause + 调整。
_meta.coverage: 6 大家族 / 19 个叶子子类（>=12 类高频风味抱怨均有判别路径）

discriminator.question_zh: 是哪种酸？选最贴近的一项。
discriminator.question_en: What kind of sour? Pick the closest.
options: 未萃取尖酸（像未熟水果刺舌）
醋酸/发酵酸（像醋或酒味）
整体偏酸但不刺（萃取不足）

leaves.label_zh: 未萃取尖酸（像未熟水果刺舌）

root_cause.zh: 果酸类先溶出但糖类未充分萃取（欠萃）
root_cause.en: Acids extracted but sugars not yet (under-extraction)

beginner_fix.zh: 粉磨细一点；延长时间。口诀:酸调细

advanced_fix.zh: 调细研磨/升水温/延长时间/提粉量比
advanced_fix.en: Finer / raise temp / longer / raise ratio

leaves.label_zh: 醋酸/发酵酸（像醋或酒味）

root_cause.zh: 豆子发酵过度、不新鲜或冲煮水温过高萃取出发酵味
root_cause.en: Over-fermented beans, stale, or too-high temp pulled ferment notes

beginner_fix.zh: 换更新鲜的豆；降低水温 2-3C

advanced_fix.zh: 排查豆源发酵处理/烘焙发展；降水温、缩短浸泡
advanced_fix.en: Check ferment process/roast dev; lower temp, shorter steep

leaves.label_zh: 整体偏酸但不刺（萃取不足）

root_cause.zh: 整体萃取不足，酸甜未平衡

beginner_fix.zh: 粉磨细一点，或多放粉少放水
beginner_fix.en: Grind finer, or more grounds less water

advanced_fix.zh: 提高粉量、调细研磨、降低粉水比（1:15->1:14）

discriminator.question_zh: 是哪种苦？选最贴近的一项。
discriminator.question_en: What kind of bitter? Pick the closest.
options: 深烘本味苦（需确认是否过）

root_cause.zh: 碳水化合物过度溶出（过萃）

beginner_fix.zh: 粉磨粗一点；缩短时间。口诀:苦调粗

advanced_fix.zh: 调粗研磨/降水温1-2C/缩短时间/降粉量比
advanced_fix.en: Coarser / drop temp 1-2C / shorter / lower ratio

root_cause.zh: 豆疵（奎克豆）/瑕疵豆或烘焙发展异常
root_cause.en: Defect beans (quakers) or abnormal roast development

beginner_fix.zh: 换一批干净豆；确认烘焙度

advanced_fix.zh: 挑除瑕疵豆/奎克豆；复核烘焙曲线发展段

root_cause.zh: 水质 TDS/硬度过高放大苦感并促过萃
root_cause.en: High TDS/hardness amplifies bitter and drives over-extraction

beginner_fix.zh: 改用过滤水或低矿化瓶装水
beginner_fix.en: Use filtered or low-mineral bottled water

advanced_fix.zh: 控 TDS 80-150ppm；相应调粗/降水温
advanced_fix.en: Control TDS 80-150ppm; coarser / lower temp accordingly

leaves.label_zh: 深烘本味苦（需确认是否过）

root_cause.zh: 深烘豆本身可可/焦香偏苦属正常，需确认是否叠加过萃
root_cause.en: Dark roast's cocoa/roasty bitter is normal; confirm no over-extraction on top

beginner_fix.zh: 若还能接受则保持；若太苦就调粗一点
beginner_fix.en: Keep if acceptable; if too bitter, grind a touch coarser

advanced_fix.zh: 区分本味苦与过萃苦：看尾段是否收口；调粗并降 time
advanced_fix.en: Separate inherent vs over-extracted: check finish; coarser + shorter

root_cause.zh: 过萃致高分子多酚/蛋白质过度提取

advanced_fix.zh: 调粗研磨、降水温、排查过萃

root_cause.zh: 布粉不均/通道效应致局部过萃
root_cause.en: Uneven distribution / channeling causes local over-extraction

beginner_fix.zh: 粉磨粗一点；注意布粉均匀

advanced_fix.zh: 调粗研磨、减粉量、优化布粉/WDT

root_cause.zh: 豆子未熟/陈豆或极浅烘发展不足

beginner_fix.zh: 换烘焙度稍深一点的豆

advanced_fix.zh: 确认烘焙发展；提水温/延长时间补足发展
advanced_fix.en: Confirm roast dev; raise temp / longer to develop

discriminator.question_en: Is it lack-of-sweet or overall weak?

root_cause.zh: 糖类未充分萃取，甜感区未到
root_cause.en: Sugars not extracted, sweet zone missed

beginner_fix.zh: 粉磨细一点，或多放粉少放水
beginner_fix.en: Grind finer, or more grounds less water

advanced_fix.zh: 提高粉量、调细研磨、降低粉水比（1:15->1:14）

root_cause.zh: 豆源/处理法本身甜感低或已失鲜
root_cause.en: Origin/process naturally low sweet or stale

beginner_fix.zh: 换风味更明显的豆（如日晒/蜜处理）

advanced_fix.zh: 换高甜感产区/处理；确认新鲜度与养豆
advanced_fix.en: Switch high-sweet origin/process; check freshness & rest

discriminator.question_zh: 是浓度低还是本身轻体？

root_cause.zh: 粉量偏低或粉水比过高致 TDS 低
root_cause.en: Low dose or high ratio -> low TDS

advanced_fix.zh: 提粉量、调粗研磨、降粉水比（1:16->1:15）

root_cause.zh: 浸泡时间/粉水比不足，萃取率低
root_cause.en: Short steep / low ratio -> low extraction

beginner_fix.zh: 延长浸泡时间，粉水比调高

advanced_fix.zh: 法压 4min+1:15；爱乐压延长浸润；提粉量
advanced_fix.en: FP 4min @1:15; AP longer bloom; raise dose

root_cause.zh: 中浅烘/特定产区本身 body 较轻，属正常
root_cause.en: Light roast / certain origins are naturally lighter body

beginner_fix.zh: 若喜欢厚 body 换中深烘豆
beginner_fix.en: If you want body, switch to medium-dark

advanced_fix.zh: 按豆性接受轻体；或用 fuller body 产区/深烘
advanced_fix.en: Accept per bean; or use fuller-body origin/dark

options: 药味/消毒水（银皮/发展不足）

root_cause.zh: 豆子老化、陈豆或仓储不当（油脂氧化）
root_cause.en: Aged/stale beans or poor storage (lipid oxidation)

beginner_fix.zh: 换新鲜烘焙的豆，注意烘焙日期
beginner_fix.en: Use fresh-roasted beans; check roast date

advanced_fix.zh: 确认烘焙日期与仓储；换新鲜豆批次
advanced_fix.en: Confirm roast date & storage; fresh batch

root_cause.zh: 深烘过火、豆疵（奎克豆）或橡胶类瑕疵豆
root_cause.en: Scorched dark roast, quakers, or rubbery defect beans

advanced_fix.zh: 排查瑕疵豆/奎克豆与烘焙曲线发展段

root_cause.zh: 厌氧/发酵处理过度或豆子不新鲜

beginner_fix.zh: 换处理法更温和的豆；降水温
beginner_fix.en: Switch to gentler process; lower temp

advanced_fix.zh: 降水温（88-90C）避免拉出发酵味；换处理法
advanced_fix.en: Lower temp (88-90C) to avoid funk; change process

leaves.label_zh: 药味/消毒水（银皮/发展不足）

root_cause.zh: 银皮过多、烘焙发展不足或特定瑕疵

beginner_fix.zh: 换豆；确认新鲜与烘焙度

advanced_fix.zh: 排查烘焙发展段与银皮；换干净批次
advanced_fix.en: Check roast development & silverskin; clean batch
